content.comment_body: Hello, I had a program originally organized across 10 vertical pages, but something changed and now the layout requires 2 pages in width and 20 in height. I'm not sure what I did to cause this.
Use the page layout tool that has been highlighted.

Hello, I had set up the pages correctly, but then the program expanded beyond the page boundaries, pushing blocks outside so they were no longer visible. The only way I could see these blocks was to increase the page count, both horizontally and vertically.

Hi, Try setting the zoom level so you can view all blocks. Select any blocks positioned outside your intended range and move them back into view. I've experienced this issue before when using copy and paste—sometimes blocks that aren't visible get selected and copied by default. As their position is fixed, these hidden blocks also end up outside the defined area. Hope this helps.
A new question posted by [user_name] was moved to a separate thread with the subject 'Nothing happens when changing the page setup from portrait to landscape.' Best regards [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter issues with their program layout in [product_name], where blocks unexpectedly move outside the set page boundaries, making some elements hidden. This impacts user experience, as controls for managing page and block visibility are not intuitive. Users find it challenging to manage layout scaling and content visibility when changing page configurations.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect blocks to remain within defined page limits and for page setup changes not to cause content to be hidden. They want clear and simple ways to recover and manage program elements that move outside the visible area.
